board.name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL), Physician Assistant Licensing Board

licence.title: Physician Assistant licence (Utah controlled substance licence is a separate licence)

ce.categoryRules: At least 40 CME hours per 2 year cycle, of which at least 34 Category 1 (ACCME standard; AAPA approved programs qualify). Up to 15% may come from documented volunteer service (4 volunteer hours = 1 CME hour). PAs specializing in mental health keep CAQ in psychiatry CME.

topicMandates.topic: Suicide prevention video or DOPL online suicide prevention training
Controlled substance prescribing classes (FDA opioid REMS blueprint content, Utah resources, documentation, medical cannabis)
topicMandates.appliesTo: holders of a Utah controlled substance licence who prescribe Schedule II or III opioids, hypnotics or psychostimulants

topicMandates.topic: SBIRT training class (required once during Utah licensure; satisfies the 3.5 hour CS requirement for the period in which it is taken)
topicMandates.appliesTo: controlled substance prescribers, beginning with the licensing period that begins after January 1, 2024

topicMandates.topic: DOPL online controlled substance database tutorial
topicMandates.appliesTo: controlled substance prescribers; waivable by attestation of database use (R156-37-402(3)(c)). The DOPL APRN with CS page requires it; the DOPL PA page lists only 3.5 hours.
PAs who are recommending medical providers (R156-70a-304(2)(a)(iii))

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 3.5 hours each cycle for CS prescribers (Utah Code 58-37-303, renumbered from 58-37-6.5 by 2026 Chapter 362). A 3.5 hour SBIRT class is required once during Utah licensure and satisfies the cycle in which it is taken. A 0.5 hour DOPL database tutorial appears on the APRN renewal page but not the PA page (not yet verified for PAs).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Under 8,500 post-graduate clinical hours: practice under written practice level policies and procedures, provided to the board on request. First 4,000 hours: collaboration with a physician. 4,000 to 8,500 hours: written collaborative agreement with a physician or a PA with over 8,500 hours in the same specialty, kept at the practice location and given to the board on request. No filing or renewal interval stated. Over 8,500 hours: no statutory collaboration agreement. Changing to a specialty with under 4,000 hours requires 4,000 hours of collaboration.
practice.notes: Thresholds were amended by 2026 General Session Chapter 96 (effective May 6, 2026); 8,500 hours replaces the prior threshold. Track hours of post-graduate clinical experience as a credential field.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Utah controlled substance licence (renews with the PA licence) plus DEA registration for controlled substances.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 3.5 hours controlled substance prescribing each cycle (or one-time SBIRT class in that cycle).

facts.quote: Physician Assistant May 31 even years

facts.value: 40 hours, at least 34 Category 1

facts.verifierNote: Current R156-70a is the version effective 2021-11-09 (adminrules API); statute 58-70a-304 unchanged since 2019.

facts.value: true

board.name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL), Board of Nursing and Certified Nurse Midwives

rn.ceNote: RN renews January 31 of odd years. Continuing competency is one of: 400 practice hours; 200 practice hours plus 15 contact hours; or 30 contact hours, in the 2 years before renewal. Suicide prevention video each renewal.

aprn.title: APRN licence (Nurse Practitioner); Utah controlled substance licence separate

topicMandates.appliesTo: APRNs holding a Utah controlled substance licence (Schedule II/III prescribers)

topicMandates.topic: SBIRT training class (required once during Utah licensure; satisfies the 3.5 hour CS requirement for the period in which it is taken)
topicMandates.appliesTo: controlled substance prescribers, beginning with the licensing period that begins after January 1, 2024

topicMandates.topic: Suicide prevention video or one DOPL online suicide prevention training (0.5 credit, counts toward CE)
DOPL online controlled substance database tutorial
topicMandates.appliesTo: APRNs holding a Utah controlled substance licence; waived if the prescriber attests to database use (R156-37-402(3)(c))

aprn.note: No separate APRN CE hour count: renewal requires current national certification in the specialty (or, if licensed before July 1, 1992, 30 CE hours and 400 practice hours). Psychiatric mental health APRNs who had not finished the clinical practice requirement at licensure must show progress or completion at renewal (58-31b-305(4)). 58-31b-305 was last amended by 2025 Chapter 392 and 58-31b-803 by 2026 Chapter 96; rule R156-31b is the January 2025 version and still cites 58-37-6.5.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Utah controlled substance licence (renews with APRN licence) plus DEA registration; no separate non controlled prescriptive authority registration found.
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 3.5 hours each cycle (statute); DOPL APRN renewal page lists 4 hours (3.5 plus 0.5 DOPL tutorial)

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: None found: Utah Code 58-31b-803 (2026) lets a licensed APRN prescribe prescription drugs including Schedule II to V with no consultation or collaboration condition for NPs (limits apply only to CRNAs).
practice.authorityNote: 'full' is a classification label; the 2026 statute text contains no collaboration or referral plan requirement for NP prescribing.

unverified: PA: the 0.5 hour DOPL controlled substance database tutorial is required on the DOPL APRN with CS renewal page and referenced as 'required' in R156-37-402(3)(c), but the DOPL PA renewal page lists only 3.5 CS hours. Whether PAs owe the 0.5 hour is not confirmed; the statute section that creates the tutorial was not found in 58-37 or 58-37f-304.
PA and NP: DOPL pages and rules R156-37-402 and R156-31b-303 still cite 58-37-6.5; the statute was renumbered 58-37-303 by 2026 Chapter 362. DOPL may revise rules.
PA: R156-70a (effective 2021-11-09) predates the 2026 Chapter 96 collaboration changes; the CE section is unaffected but the board may amend it.
NP: the specific 58-37 section requiring a Utah controlled substance licence for APRNs was not quoted; it rests on R156-31b-303(3)(b)(ii) and the DOPL APRN with CS renewal page.
NP: 'full' practice authority is a classification label, not statutory wording; 58-31b-803 (eff. 5/6/2026) has no collaboration condition for NPs.
